Firecrawl's $75M Series B was led by Smash Capital (also reported as Smash Ventures), and the company announced it on September 22, 2026, alongside its Alexandria data platform. Other investors included Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures. No valuation was disclosed.

Reporting differs on a few details:
- **Form D discrepancy:** An SEC Form D filed by the legal issuer showed about $82.1M in preferred stock sold, and the filing didn't name investors or give a valuation. RuntimeWire noted the announced amount is about $7.1M less than that figure, and neither disclosure explains the gap.
- **Prior round:** One source puts the Series A at $20.7M, led by Nexus and Y Combinator. Another says $14.5M.
- **Headquarters and founding year:** Sources differ on headquarters (San Francisco vs. Los Angeles) and founding year (2024 vs. 2022 on Dealroom's profile).

content.text:
Firecrawl raised **$75M** in its Series B. **Smash Capital** led the round, which some outlets call Smash Ventures. The company announced it on September 22, 2026, and launched **Alexandria** alongside it. Alexandria is a data library for AI agents, built on Firecrawl's web crawling. Other investors included Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures. No valuation was disclosed.

Reports disagree on a few details:
- **Round size:** An SEC Form D showed about $82.1M in preferred stock sold. That is roughly $7.1M more than the announced $75M, and nothing I found explains the gap.
- **Series A:** One source gives $20.7M, led by Nexus and Y Combinator. Another says $14.5M.

Sources:
- [Web-Scraping Firm Firecrawl Raises $75M Series B Led by Smash Ventures (AI Weekly)](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/web-scraping-firm-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-led-by-smash-ventures-for-ai)
- [Firecrawl raises $75M Series B to build a knowledge library for AI agents (Dealroom)](https://dealroom.co/news/155341-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-to-build-a-knowledge-library-for-ai-agents/)
- [Firecrawl raises $75M to turn web crawling into an agent data library (RuntimeWire)](https://runtimewire.com/article/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-alexandria-ai-agent-data)
